name: Komikado Kazuki
source:
Hometown: Izumo Province
Good at: Cheating
Favorite things: Spicy things, gambling

Sennosha private school's cool student council president and the student whom everyone looks up to. Perfect in everything - be it sports, studying or just anything, Kazuki is a woman worth calling a genius. She also has an extensive network and almost controls the school with her charisma. Despite all this, Kazuki is an extreme drinker, a gambler and a cold-hearted tactician.
